task.instruction: Choose exactly one authority mode for next week—central allotment or a store token market—then specify who owns allotment, exceptions, SKU mix, and conflict resolution. Hybrid authority is unavailable. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: Five stores used local overrides and stockouts fell 2.8 percentage points.
Truck capacity is 80 pallets; simultaneous requests totaled 94; 14 were deferred for two days.
The ledger can enforce exactly one mode: central allotment of all 80 pallets with no store trades, or five 16-token store accounts with trades but no central override. The mode locks at 18:00.

Next week has 12 promotions: eight chainwide forecast daily and four local-only forecast from hourly footfall. Central forecasts missed three local spikes last week; local overrides delayed two chainwide items.
A research-vessel voyage had 70 deck slots, requests for 82, and 12 delayed samples; one shore desk held final allocation authority.
A theatre season used 60 lighting-unit credits, venue teams saw hourly rehearsals, local exchanges were reversible until noon, and no inventory overflow occurred for eight weeks.
